UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Signed-in Google user profile and sync metadata.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document path.

displayName.description: User display name from Google account.

email.description: User email address (optional PII stored strictly under owner-only profile).

lastSyncedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last completed library sync.

colorHex.description: ARGB color integer for folder badge.

locked.description: Whether the folder requires local Vault PIN/biometric unlock.

clientCreatedAtMs.description: Original device creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

CloudDocument.title: CloudDocument
CloudDocument.description: Synced scanned document metadata, OCR text, AI summary, and compact cover thumbnail.

tags.description: Up to 20 string tags associated with this document.

locked.description: Whether document export or vault state is locked.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the document.

lastExportFormat.description: Most recent export format (e.g., PDF, JPEG).

clientCreatedAtMs.description: Original scan creation epoch time in milliseconds.

clientUpdatedAtMs.description: Most recent local edit epoch time in milliseconds.

deletedAtMs.description: Optional Recycle Bin soft-delete timestamp in milliseconds.

ocrText.description: Extracted OCR full-text index (up to 25,000 characters).

aiSummary.description: Optional Gemini AI summary (up to 4,000 characters).

coverThumbnailBase64.description: Compact base64-encoded JPEG cover preview (<= 250,000 chars).

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: Synced folder catalog owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/documents/{docId}.description: Synced scanned document metadata, OCR text, and compact preview owned by userId.
